pharmacological_mechanism: Additive hyperkalemia: high potassium load combined with reduced aldosterone-mediated excretion.
adverse_clinical_risk: Cardiac conduction abnormalities, peaked T-waves, bradycardia, muscle weakness, and ventricular fibrillation.
dietary_action_guidance: Avoid heavy servings of Matooke or roasted Gonja around the time of your dose. Do not take alongside potassium salt substitutes.

pharmacological_mechanism: Potassium accumulation via competitive aldosterone antagonism compounded by potassium-dense plantain intake.
adverse_clinical_risk: Severe hyperkalemia, cardiac arrest, lethargy, muscle paralysis, and paresthesias.
dietary_action_guidance: Space doses away from high-potassium banana/plantain meals; have serum potassium checked periodically.

pharmacological_mechanism: Aldehyde dehydrogenase enzyme inhibition resulting in blood acetaldehyde toxicity.
adverse_clinical_risk: Violent vomiting, severe abdominal cramps, throbbing headache, chest palpitations, and sudden hypotension.
dietary_action_guidance: Strictly zero alcohol during treatment and for at least 72 hours after finishing the full course of Metronidazole.

pharmacological_mechanism: CYP2E1 induction accelerates production of toxic NAPQI metabolite while depleting hepatic glutathione.
adverse_clinical_risk: Acute hepatic cell necrosis, liver failure, and jaundice.
dietary_action_guidance: Never take Panadol or Hedex after drinking alcohol. Do not exceed 2,000 mg in 24 hours if alcohol is consumed regularly.

pharmacological_mechanism: Ethanol impairs hepatic gluconeogenesis and inhibits lactate clearance, promoting lactic acid buildup.
adverse_clinical_risk: Severe lactic acidosis: Kussmaul breathing, profound lethargy, hypothermia, cardiovascular shock.
dietary_action_guidance: Do not drink alcohol while taking Metformin. Ensure adequate hydration and regular carbohydrate intake.

pharmacological_mechanism: High protein content floods LAT-1 transporters, blocking levodopa intestinal absorption and BBB transit.
adverse_clinical_risk: Sudden onset of severe motor freezing, tremors, and loss of Parkinson's symptom control.
dietary_action_guidance: Take your medication 60 minutes before or 2 hours after meals containing rich groundnut sauce or roasted peanuts.

pharmacological_mechanism: Massive dietary Vitamin K1 directly restores prothrombin complex synthesis, neutralizing Warfarin effect.
adverse_clinical_risk: Sudden drop in INR below therapeutic target (1.5-2.0), triggering stroke, DVT, or pulmonary embolism.
dietary_action_guidance: Do not make sudden changes to how much Sukuma Wiki or Dodo you eat. Keep your weekly intake constant.

pharmacological_mechanism: Multivalent mineral cations (Ca2+, Mg2+, Fe3+) and phytates form non-absorbable drug complexes.
adverse_clinical_risk: Up to 80% decrease in antibiotic absorption resulting in uneliminated bacterial infection and drug resistance.
dietary_action_guidance: Take Ciprofloxacin 2 hours before or 4 hours after consuming Bushera or fortified porridge.

pharmacological_mechanism: Divalent calcium and magnesium in unrefined millet form insoluble insoluble chelates in the gut.
adverse_clinical_risk: Drastic reduction in doxycycline serum concentrations, leading to therapeutic failure in respiratory/pelvic infections.
dietary_action_guidance: Take Doxycycline with a full glass of plain water 2 hours before or 3 hours after millet porridge.

pharmacological_mechanism: High bioavailable calcium from ingested intact bones chelates the fluoroquinolone core.
adverse_clinical_risk: Blunted peak drug concentration, lowering therapeutic efficacy against soft tissue and urinary infections.
dietary_action_guidance: Allow at least a 2-hour window between eating Mukene dishes and swallowing Ciprofloxacin tablets.

pharmacological_mechanism: Heavy exogenous purine load from whole-fish sardines overwhelms xanthine oxidase inhibition.
adverse_clinical_risk: Acute gout flare, severe joint inflammation (first metatarsophalangeal), and hyperuricemia.
dietary_action_guidance: Limit consumption of whole-bone dried fish (Mukene) during acute gout therapy; drink plenty of water.

pharmacological_mechanism: Polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) induce hepatic CYP1A2, accelerating drug elimination.
adverse_clinical_risk: Sub-therapeutic theophylline levels leading to severe acute asthma attacks or COPD exacerbations.
dietary_action_guidance: Avoid eating heavily charred, flame-grilled, or smoked meats. Inform your clinician if your diet changes.

pharmacological_mechanism: Extreme tartaric acid content enhances salicylate absorption while breaking down the gastric mucosal barrier.
adverse_clinical_risk: Severe gastritis, peptic ulcer perforation, and upper GI hemorrhage.
dietary_action_guidance: Avoid sour tamarind drinks or pastes when taking regular aspirin or anti-inflammatory painkillers.

pharmacological_mechanism: Acidic mucosal irritation combined with enhanced NSAID bioavailability increases gastric erosion rate.
adverse_clinical_risk: Stomach ulceration, epigastric burning, nausea, and acute occult gastrointestinal bleeding.
dietary_action_guidance: Space tamarind intake at least 4 hours away from ibuprofen, and always take ibuprofen with bland food.

pharmacological_mechanism: Flavonoids inhibit CYP3A4-mediated oxidation of amlodipine while providing additive arterial vasodilation.
adverse_clinical_risk: Acute hypotension, orthostatic lightheadedness, syncope, and exaggerated peripheral edema.
dietary_action_guidance: Avoid taking concentrated Moringa herbal supplements alongside calcium channel blockers without monitoring blood pressure.

pharmacological_mechanism: Synergistic stimulation of insulin release and enhanced peripheral glucose uptake.
adverse_clinical_risk: Uncontrolled hypoglycemia: shakiness, confusion, fainting, seizures, and neuroglycopenic coma.
dietary_action_guidance: Do not self-medicate with high-dose Moringa powders while on sulfonylureas. Test fingerstick glucose frequently.

pharmacological_mechanism: Adsorption and chemical binding: clay minerals bind iron ions into an insoluble insoluble mass.
adverse_clinical_risk: Complete block of iron absorption, severe refractory microcytic hypochromic anemia in pregnancy.
dietary_action_guidance: Avoid eating clay within 4 hours of taking iron tablets. Address underlying iron deficiency pica with a midwife.

pharmacological_mechanism: Clay silicates and mineral cations physically bind the antibiotic molecules within the GI tract.
adverse_clinical_risk: Zero systemic antibiotic absorption, progression of untreated systemic or urinary infections.
dietary_action_guidance: Do not consume clay or earthen minerals during antibiotic therapy; take medication with clean water only.

pharmacological_mechanism: Anthraquinone glycosides induce rapid potassium excretion in the colon, precipitating hypokalemia.
adverse_clinical_risk: Myocardial sensitization to digoxin toxicity: fatal ventricular arrhythmias, xanthopsia, nausea, heart block.
dietary_action_guidance: Never drink homemade Aloe Vera concoctions while taking Digoxin. Report heart palpitations immediately.

pharmacological_mechanism: Dual potassium wasting through both renal loop inhibition and colonic secretory stimulation.
adverse_clinical_risk: Profound hypokalemia, cardiac palpitations, severe leg cramps, dehydration, and prerenal azotemia.
dietary_action_guidance: Avoid combining Aloe vera laxative juices with prescription loop diuretics.

pharmacological_mechanism: Cathinone acts as a potent sympathomimetic releasing noradrenaline, overriding beta-blocker effects.
adverse_clinical_risk: Hypertensive crisis, severe reflex vasoconstriction, cerebral hemorrhage, and chest angina.
dietary_action_guidance: Strictly avoid chewing Khat/Mairungi while taking medications for high blood pressure or heart rate control.

pharmacological_mechanism: Additive inhibition of catecholamine reuptake produces severe adrenergic surge and serotonin excess.
adverse_clinical_risk: Agitation, hyperpyrexia, cardiac tachyarrhythmias, hallucinations, and potential Serotonin Syndrome.
dietary_action_guidance: Do not chew Khat while on antidepressant medications. Seek medical care if experiencing chest tightness.

pharmacological_mechanism: Synergistic natriuresis and vasodilation between plant anthocyanins/acids and thiazide diuretic.
adverse_clinical_risk: Excessive fluid depletion, orthostatic hypotension (blackouts upon standing), and hypokalemia.
dietary_action_guidance: Drink hibiscus tea in moderation. Avoid taking large glasses simultaneously with morning diuretic doses.

pharmacological_mechanism: Urinary acidification and accelerated glucuronidation/renal clearance decreases drug exposure.
adverse_clinical_risk: Diminished pain relief duration and early return of fever or inflammatory symptoms.
dietary_action_guidance: Take Paracetamol with warm water rather than concentrated acidic Hibiscus brews.

pharmacological_mechanism: Unknown metabolic interaction; dietary lipids and trace vitamin K inhibit warfarin response.
adverse_clinical_risk: Resistance to anticoagulation, decreased INR, and increased risk of thromboembolism.
dietary_action_guidance: Consume avocado in consistent, moderate quantities. Avoid sudden large dietary increases while on Warfarin.

pharmacological_mechanism: Polyphenolic catechins and tannins bind non-heme and supplemental iron into insoluble precipitates.
adverse_clinical_risk: Up to 75% reduction in iron absorption, preventing recovery from anemia and prolonging exhaustion.
dietary_action_guidance: Take iron supplements with plain water or vitamin C rich fresh juice, at least 2 hours before/after tea.

pharmacological_mechanism: High calcium casein micelles chelate the tetracycline ring, blocking enteral absorption.
adverse_clinical_risk: Severely reduced antibiotic bioavailability, leading to treatment failure in pelvic, skin, or lung infections.
dietary_action_guidance: Take Doxycycline with a full glass of water. Wait at least 2 hours before drinking milk or taking dairy products.

pharmacological_mechanism: Soy isoflavones and fiber bind thyroxine in the intestinal tract, inhibiting absorption.
adverse_clinical_risk: Persistent hypothyroidism: weight gain, lethargy, cold intolerance, and elevated TSH levels.
dietary_action_guidance: Take Levothyroxine first thing in the morning with water; wait at least 4 hours before consuming soy products.

pharmacological_mechanism: Garlic supplements and high allicin intake induce CYP3A4, accelerating antiretroviral clearance.
adverse_clinical_risk: Sub-therapeutic ARV plasma levels, risking HIV viral load rebound and development of drug resistance.
dietary_action_guidance: Avoid concentrated garlic pills or heavy raw garlic extracts while taking Efavirenz-based ARV regimens.

pharmacological_mechanism: Capsaicin stimulates pulmonary sensory C-fibers and substance P release, mirroring bradykinin pathways.
adverse_clinical_risk: Severe exacerbation of intractable dry ACE-inhibitor cough and throat irritation.
dietary_action_guidance: Reduce dietary hot pepper / Kamulali if experiencing persistent coughing while taking Lisinopril or Enalapril.
